title: LOIN completeness snapshot from an exported instance-parameter schedule: fill rate per model, field and category, family elements only
use_when: The client asks where the project stands on information requirements (LOIN) and every model carries the same instance-parameter schedule
A weekly report needs a completeness number and a ranked list of gaps
not_for: Checking values for correctness: this counts filled, not right
Type parameters that the schedule does not show per instance

environment.batch_tool: ZEN ACC Gate 'Export Schedules' (one CSV per schedule and model)
environment.model: Autodesk sample Snowdon Towers, 6 cloud discipline models, 20,327 instances

changelog.change: First recorded (IN-0017, curator session with the owner)
v02: count by unique id, report nested/sub-element/system rows separately, score against the per-discipline LOIN table, trace 0% fields to their source before asking teams (IN-0020)
